# Old System Inventory

## Major recoverable layers
- Discord as live command and ops surface
- OpenClaw as agent/runtime/orchestration layer
- vault as durable filesystem knowledge base
- QMD as indexing/query/search substrate
- session summaries and persistent memory habits
- inbox/capture/promote workflows
- graph/ontology extraction ambitions
- maintenance/freshness/health scoring loops

## Practical old-system strengths
- real ambient usage through Discord
- agent-readable workspace continuity
- direct filesystem truth
- QMD-backed search/query habits
- durable session memory instead of disposable chat
- maintenance culture around staleness and quality

## Main reconciliation question
How do these become EMA-native capabilities rather than detached legacy systems?
